facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at PSV-7102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-7102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-7102 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 26 February 2024 a planned assurance activity of PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems not effective.
